parsed.attack: The plausible incumbent is Duolingo, which now generates courses with models rather than curriculum teams and added roughly 148 of them in a single 2025 release, so South Asian heritage languages from English stop being a build decision and become a content-generation toggle; it already ships unscripted spoken practice via Video Call and already owns this audience's habit. Google Translate's free Practice feature covers Punjabi and Gujarati today, at no cost, with no install and no subscription. A freemium spaced-repetition app in a category the author's own evidence says died of distribution has to price against both.
parsed.strongest_defence: Neither can ship the wedge, because the study material is one named grandmother's own recorded voice and the fifty phrases for one recurring Sunday call. Central curriculum publishers deliberately refuse user-generated audio as a quality and moderation liability, which is why Duolingo shut its volunteer contributor programme in 2021, and Google will not build a product whose core asset is a family's private recordings. An incumbent shipping a Gujarati course validates the pull and raises the ceiling without touching the personal corpus this product accumulates.
parsed.verdict_reason: What is being sold is one family's own recordings and one learner's review history, which the category leaders' centrally-published content model and quality promise structurally forbid them from shipping.
